source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Use regular activity, relaxation skills, adequate sleep, and supportive social connections","B":"Wait for workplace stress to resolve without using any deliberate coping or recovery strategy","C":"Reduce physical activity during stressful periods to conserve energy for work responsibilities","D":"Rely on caffeine and alcohol to manage stress, improve sleep, and maintain daily performance"}}
source_row.rationale: Evidence-based stress management strategies include regular physical activity, relaxation techniques (such as deep breathing, mindfulness, or meditation), adequate sleep, maintaining social connections/support, and, when needed, professional support — all of which can help mitigate the negative health effects of chronic stress.
source_row.source_detail: CDC/NIOSH stress resources: physical activity, relaxation, sleep, and social support; reviewed 2026-08-14.
